name: KDIPA Long-Term Investor Residency

requirements.blocker_text: Requires a KDIPA-licensed investment entity with an investment value of no less than KWD 5,000,000, and minimum capital of KWD 1,000,000 for the approved investment activity. Eligible applicants include owners of KDIPA-licensed entities, partners in licensed companies, and KDIPA-approved senior executives (plus their eligible immediate family). The business must be actively operating in Kuwait and comply with minimum Kuwaiti-national employment requirements.
requirements.fix_path: License an investment entity with KDIPA meeting the KWD 5,000,000 investment-value and KWD 1,000,000 capital thresholds.

evidence_required.document: Proof of investment value and capital
Evidence of active business operations and Kuwaiti-employment compliance

sources.title: Kuwait Direct Investment Promotion Authority (KDIPA), Kuwait's government investment-promotion authority -- official announcement of a 15-year (renewable) residency scheme for KDIPA-licensed investors, partners, and approved senior executives, requiring KWD 5,000,000 investment value and KWD 1,000,000 minimum capital, issued under Law No. 114 of 2024 in coordination with the Ministry of Interior

notes: NEW COUNTRY BUILD (Kuwait). STATUS: PUBLISHED -- direct KDIPA government sourcing, tier 1. This is a genuinely high threshold relative to comparable routes built elsewhere in this dataset (contrast Tunisia, Iran, and Lebanon's no-minimum-threshold investor routes, or Kenya's US$100,000 and Ghana's up to US$1,000,000 tiers) -- Kuwait's KWD 5,000,000 figure (roughly USD 16 million at typical exchange rates, not independently converted/verified in this build) targets substantial existing investment entities rather than first-time individual investors. family_can_work set false since the source confirms eligible family members may be included in the residency grant but does not state they gain independent work rights.
